title: Qualify and advertise cloth contact
requires: Each driver that will advertise either cloth scope
scope: Run public-API physical, topology, capacity and lifecycle gates before exposing self or separate-system cloth contact.
acceptance: Folded-self, two-sheet, high-speed, friction, conservation, tearing and long-run cases pass per advertising driver.
Capability evidence reports self and separate-system limits independently and does not imply attachment or containment.
